readerCopy.body: One conversation can make the next decision impossible to keep vague. When Mercury conjuncts the North Node, a message, application, introduction, contract term, or answer to one important question can put a concrete choice where speculation had been. You may still need time to decide, but now you know what you are deciding about. Get the date, amount, requirement, name, or answer that changes your options, then stop planning around information you no longer need to guess at.
